arrivalFAQ.title: Getting to Koh Samui — Quick FAQ
arrivalFAQ.lead: Only USM (Koh Samui Airport) and the island piers count as your final arrival. Everything else is still in transit — even if you've already landed in Thailand.
arrivalFAQ.printBlocked: Pop-up blocked — please allow pop-ups to print.
arrivalFAQ.arrivedNote: You've arrived. No further transit steps needed.

next.pre_departure: Confirm you've landed once you reach Thailand.
next.bkk: Catch your connecting flight to USM, or onward to URT for the ferry.
next.dmk: Catch your connecting flight (USM or URT). Allow 4+ hrs if transferring to BKK.
next.urt: Take the shuttle to Donsak pier, then ferry to Nathon or Lipa Noi.
next.ferry: Tell us when you're a few minutes from the pier.
next.pier: Pickup activates — your driver is on the way.
next.usm: Pickup activates — your driver is on the way.

q.why: Why doesn't BKK / DMK / URT count as "arrived"?
q.whatToTell: What should I tell staff at each stage?

a.why: Those airports are on the Thai mainland. You still need a connecting flight or a ferry to reach the island. Until your feet hit Samui, the team treats you as in transit — pickup isn't dispatched yet, but staff can see your route.

bkkUsm.title: Scenario: BKK → USM (direct connection)
bkkUsm.body: You land at BKK, clear immigration, then catch your domestic leg to Samui (USM). The system shows you as in transit — Bangkok until USM lands. Once USM lands, status flips to arrived and pickup goes live.

dmkUsm.title: Scenario: DMK → USM (budget Bangkok route)
dmkUsm.body: Don Mueang is Bangkok's second airport — usually cheaper, mostly budget carriers. Same rule: landing at DMK keeps you in transit. Final arrival is USM. Heads up: BKK and DMK are not the same airport — leave 4+ hours if connecting.

urtFerry.title: Scenario: DMK / BKK → URT → ferry → Samui
urtFerry.body: The budget route. Fly into Surat Thani (URT), then ferry to Nathon or Lipa Noi pier. Status stays in transit through both URT and the ferry. Final arrival = the pier you land at on Samui.

usmDirect.title: Scenario: Direct flight straight to USM
usmDirect.body: Easiest path. You land, you're arrived. No transit state. Pickup (if enabled) goes live the moment USM logs your landing.

script.title: Message to send staff
script.desc: Copy this and send it on any messaging channel you've connected.

scriptText.bkk: Hi — I just landed at BKK (Bangkok Suvarnabhumi). Heading to my connecting flight now. I'll message again when I'm closer to Samui.
scriptText.dmk: Hi — I just landed at DMK (Don Mueang). Catching my next flight soon. Will update once I'm in Samui.
scriptText.urt: Hi — I've landed at Surat Thani (URT). Heading to the ferry to Samui. I'll let you know when I'm on the boat.
scriptText.ferry: Hi — I'm on the ferry to Samui now. Will message again when I'm a few minutes from the pier.
scriptText.pier: Hi — just reached the pier on Samui (Nathon / Lipa Noi). Ready for pickup.
scriptText.usm: Hi — landed at USM (Koh Samui Airport). Ready for pickup.

print.ruleBody: BKK, DMK and URT are mainland transit checkpoints — staff sees you in transit until you reach Koh Samui. USM (Samui Airport) and the Nathon / Lipa Noi piers count as final arrival. Pickup activates only at final arrival.
